baseline_fields.evidence_summary: PCEF convergence now includes portable agent state, real repository process-death recovery, versioned SPCA evaluations, plus a bounded A2A 1.0 HTTP+JSON compatibility edge. Two independent 8x8 processes complete router-to-specialist delegation with stable context, parent-receipt lineage, authority non-escalation, Artifact digest binding and PCEF terminal verification. Independent third-party A2A interoperability, authenticated production A2A, native device-local binding, external-provider exactly-once delivery and privacy-preserving attestation remain unproven.
baseline_fields.single_extra_feature: Sovereign Proof-Carrying Autonomy: standards-facing agent interoperability whose completion remains governed by proof-carrying authority, effects, verification and truth boundaries.
baseline_fields.8x8_parity_gate: Add independent third-party A2A compatibility, production authentication/HTTPS, per-tool guardrails/traces and sandbox-first risky execution while retaining PCEF as the only completion law.

frontier_patch.definition: Every consequential agent/tool/external effect must carry an authorization-bound, idempotent, replay-verifiable proof receipt before terminal completion; standards-facing inter-agent operations must preserve context, authority and receipt lineage; a future privacy-preserving attestation layer may prove policy compliance without disclosing prompts, secrets or private topology.
frontier_patch.why_it_is_one_feature: It is one proof-carrying completion law applied uniformly to local agents, interoperable agent tasks, tools, connectors and external effects rather than a bundle of unrelated product features.
